subject: Deep-dive request: SOC 2 Type II - targeted MFA/logging/access-review slices + bridge timeline
messages:
From: Samuel Perez <samuel.perez@veritas-io.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@healthbridge.com, audit@veritas-io.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II follow-up and targeted control artifacts

Hi Rachel,

Thank you for sharing Redwood's SOC 2 Type II PDF last quarter. For HealthBridge's ongoing SIG review we need a short set of supplemental artifacts tied to the 2026 Type II period. To keep the request focused, can you provide the following by the end of next week (COB 2026-12-27)?

1) Scoped MFA/authentication logs: a CSV slice covering 2026-01-01 through 2026-05-31 with anonymized principal identifiers and fields: timestamp, event_type (login/sso/fail), auth_method (password/mfa/sso), device_ip (masked), and session_id. We only need a representative sample — roughly 10k rows — plus a brief extraction note describing sampling method and any redaction applied.

2) Privileged access review summary for Q1 2026: list of deprovisioned accounts, justification notes where applicable, and the attestation records from the owners. An aggregate Excel or CSV is fine.

3) Keystore/secret rotation evidence: dates and short notes for any customer-facing key rotations in the audit window (rotation artifacts or ticket ids suffice).

4) A short bridge letter confirming the intended SOC 2 coverage period and whether there are any known exceptions or scope changes that HealthBridge should be aware of.

If any of the above are not routinely exported or need additional approvals, tell us what you can provide and an estimated delivery date. If you prefer to redline the request, we can accept a narrower slice; the goal is to show control operation beyond the report.

Thanks — Sam
Samuel Perez
Sr. Assurance Manager | Veritas Assurance
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II follow-up and targeted control artifacts

Team—

Per Veritas / HealthBridge request below. This is time-sensitive (delivery target COB 12/27). Kimberly/Neha — can you confirm what we can produce without additional approvals and the estimated export sizes? Markus — can you confirm whether the keystore rotation tickets are centralized in Jira and which IDs to include.

Specific asks and our initial notes:
- MFA slice (10k rows target): Neha — we need a pseudonymized export; include a short sampling description (random user sampling with stratification by region). Please avoid PII in the export.
- Privileged access review Q1: Kimberly — do we have an attestation summary spreadsheet from the quarterly review? If not, can you generate a spreadsheet with columns: account, role, owner, deprovisioned_date, justification (free text), attested_by, attestation_date.
- Keystore rotation evidence: Markus — list of rotations during 2026-01-01—2026-05-31 plus ticket links. If any rotation was performed in a customer-facing path, flag it.
- Bridge letter: I can draft a brief bridge confirming the coverage window and noting no exceptions discovered in our internal review; I will circulate for legal sign-off.

Please reply with timelines and attach any extracts you can share to this thread. If export work needs infra time, call it out now.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
